# Event Decorator Portfolio - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
React.js portfolio website for an event decorator business to showcase decoration photos and videos.

## Tech Stack
- React 18+ with Vite
- CSS Modules for styling
- Responsive design
- Modern UI/UX patterns

## Project Structure
- Hero section with business introduction
- About section
- Services showcase
- Photo/Video gallery with categorization
- Contact section

## Development Guidelines
- Use functional components with hooks
- Implement responsive design (mobile-first)
- Optimize images and videos for web
- Ensure smooth scrolling and transitions
- Use placeholder content for media assets

## Status
✅ Project setup initiated
